fact: The ICT Authority, under KDEAP, held a two-day workshop with ministries, departments and agencies on 6-7 November 2025 on Government Enterprise Architecture and the national e-Government Interoperability Framework, and says it will develop and finalize the national GEA standards and interoperability framework, so none is yet final.
system: National e-Government Interoperability Framework and Government Enterprise Architecture standards

fact: The ICT Authority's 2nd Edition Government Enterprise Architecture and Government Interoperability Framework sets out a framework for standardised data exchange between government agencies (interoperability charter, data, technical and metadata standards), but its approval date and document history are blank and its scope section says it is to be adopted by the entire government, ministries, counties and agencies; the document gives no date for the events and is dated by its 2023 publication year.
system: Government Enterprise Architecture (GEA) and Government Interoperability Framework (GIF)
